full_details: Five mornings remain before Saturday. Nick held Juliet under the note, and Phillips stopped him when the name lifted him. Pope's question about the Nurse was put to Wednesday. At the White Greyhound, Harrison reported, as of a third party, that Cuthbert Burby entered a play of King Edward the Third this morning. You asked if Burby had asked leave. He said, of whom. Sixpence to the Hall buys a title its place, and the title names no company, no hands, and no author. You remembered lilies that fester, which are also in the folder at home, and you did not open the folder. The afternoon was Navarre. You played. At night you wrote an unfinished page of the tradesmen and did not count the leaves.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the window under the note, heard at Paul's that Burby had entered Edward the Third, and made no claim.
title: Burby entered Edward the Third
